One dollar face of pre-1965 90% dimes, quarters or halves holds 0.723392 troy oz (22.5 g), worth 35.57 USD now; dealers often quote 0.715 oz per dollar for worn coins. With a 10% dealer spread, a buyer would offer about 160.06 USD. As-minted silver content; worn coins hold slightly less.
